title: Head of International Sales
Identify_Pain__c: Responsible for selling by-product, wanted to know what ASIA was selling at, so he can price himself accordingly. Knows Veronika and exchange data: one of the UK's largest rendering and animal by-products processing companies. They sit directly in the market segments you cover: animal fats, tallow, protein meals, MBM, pet food ingredients, biodiesel feedstocks, renewable fuels, and food waste recycling. He was particularly interested in understanding where Asian sellers are pricing, which suggests an export/competitive benchmarking use case rather than just domestic UK pricing. There may be a need around visibility into Asian animal protein/fat markets, international trade flows, and how UK/European material compares against Asian-origin offers.
